links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses to patient questions (FKGL, SMOG) versus recommended thresholds
links.effect: ChatGPT required a higher reading level than Gemini (FKGL 12.6 vs 11.2; SMOG 11.3 vs 10.0). Both models exceeded recommended readability thresholds.
links.quote: Both models exceeded recommended readability thresholds, highlighting a gap between informational quality and linguistic accessibility in AI-generated health communication.

screen.reason: Evaluates baseline performance and readability of two off-the-shelf LLMs (ChatGPT and Gemini) answering patient questions on isotretinoin without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
